subset.rule: 全部 713 对（ICML 2025 的 ML 部分，GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 两种插入模型都用）；不用非 ML 的 CS 扩展。阶段三的训练题和留出题由 #157 选。

sections:
## 共同的问题

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | 判官看不到被测系统拿到的材料，也看不到系统自己的代码和产出 | PaperWritingBench 的 SxS 只读两篇论文（官方 `sxs_paper_quality.py`、`sxs_lit_review_quality.py`）；PaperWrite-Bench 的幻觉检查只拿原论文 LaTeX 对照（`evaluate_per_section.py` 的 pass 1）；ResearchClawBench 的判官只读报告、checklist 和图（`evaluation/score.py`） | 系统自己补出的方法细节、记错方法的数字、没有代码算过的数字都发现不了，有时还被当作优点加分（P1） | 新增 `faithfulness-judge`：逐条核对文档对自身工作的陈述与材料（和评测侧的参照）是否一致。验证见 P1、W3、R1 |
| C2 | 判官模型被替换，且去掉了采样参数 | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 由 Antigravity 以 `gemini-4-argon-high` 服务；GPT 判官（`gpt-4o`、`gpt-5`、`gpt-5.1`、`gpt-5.4`）由 codex-api 以 `gpt-5.6-sol`、effort medium 服务；`temperature`、`top_p` 被去掉（`codex_api.toml`） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数记录实际服务的模型。替代判官有锚点：PaperWritingBench 原论文对其逐字节副本的 SxS 8 次全平（#42 调查）；ScienceAgentBench 图像判官对全部图像题做了 gold、他题 gold、空白三种锚点（S5）；ResearchClawBench 同一报告重复打分（R5） |
| C3 | 一次打分会波动 | ResearchClawBench 同一份报告五次打分在 23.7 和 29.3 之间（R5）；PaperWrite-Bench 同一份论文（运行 R2）重新打分，rubric 3.56 变 3.61、重大幻觉 1 条变 4 条、claim 241 条变 227 条（本 Issue）；PaperWritingBench 同一篇论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）的文献综述 #42 打 58 / 57（Gemini / GPT），本 Issue 重新打分 51 / 52；SxS 的胜负两次相同 | 单题、单次的差几分不说明问题 | ResearchClawBench 每次打分另打 2 次，报告均值、标准差和极差（`project_checks.repeats`）；其余两项单次打分要 20 次以上调用，只在汇总上比较 |
| C4 | 离线题不是完全断网：屏蔽放行 Python 包索引 | PaperWrite-Bench 的官方写作 agent 没有网络工具，ASI-Bench 榜单页写“没有外部工具访问”，PhysClosureBench 的 `network_access` 是 `disabled`；本项目这三个 benchmark 的题目以 `offline` 屏蔽运行，另放行 `pypi.org/simple/` 和 `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` 的 `GET`/`HEAD`（设置 `shield.package_index`，每次运行的 `setup.network` 写 `package_index: allowed`，#105） | 被测系统能 pip 装包，官方 agent 不能；包索引不含题目答案，也不含论文内容，其他站点（文献、论文、代码托管、搜索）照旧 403，屏蔽表（原论文、仓库）先于放行生效 | 记入每次运行的记录和看板；不改官方评分；读离线题的结果时按此条理解联网条件 |

## FLAWS（`flaws-judge`）

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | 答案里没有任何摘录，或 Levenshtein 匹配超过 300 秒时，官方判为命中 | 官方 `calculate_levenshtein` 对空预测列表返回 1，`levenshtein_identify` 因此返回 True（固定 commit 80309b1 的真实函数，空列表实测返回 True；对一段毫不相干的摘录返回 False）；`levenshtein_identify` 用 `run_with_timeout(…, timeout=300)`，超时分支返回初值 True | 交了空文件或格式不对（没有 `:error_text:`）的运行会拿到一个命中，抬高准确率；摘录很长时 Levenshtein 的纯 Python 动态规划可能超过 300 秒，同样记为命中 | 官方值记在 `metrics.official_hit`；`metrics.hit` 和 `hit_at_*` 在没有摘录或超时时记 0，并在 `project_checks.empty_prediction`、`project_checks.levenshtein_timeout` 写明。没交 `answer.txt` 的运行没有分数（`score` 报错） |
| F2 | 判官被替换，且不再是插入错误的模型 | 官方 `evaluate_llm.py` 的 `insertion_families`：Gemini 2.5 Pro 判它自己插入的 448 对，GPT-5 判它插入的 265 对；这里 713 对都由 codex-api 服务的 `gpt-5.6-sol`（effort medium，去掉 temperature 和 safety_identifier）判 | 官方判官认得自己写的错误风格，可能偏宽；换成 GPT 后 Gemini 插入的对不再是“自评”，两部分的宽严与官方不同；分数不与官方榜单直接可比 | 每条分数的 `judge` 记实际服务的模型和用量，`insertion` 记这对由谁插入；比较系统时两种插入模型的对一起看，必要时分别报；不改提示和匹配规则 |
| F3 | 命中判据对摘录长度很宽松，且长度上限只写在提示里 | Levenshtein 取摘录对插入文本、定位摘录的“句子后缀”最佳相似度；LLM 判官的匹配标准是“一方是另一方的子集”。官方代码不检查摘录长度是否不超过 `word_limit`，也不检查条数 | 一段很长、包住错误处的摘录可能凭子集规则命中；对 coding agent 比对聊天模型更容易做到（能复制整段原文） | 官方分数照录；`project_checks.answer_form` 记超过 10 条的条数、超过 `word_limit` 的摘录数。该影响未测量 |
| F4 | 提示带着由答案算出的词数上限；末段摘录带着 `:explanation:` | 官方 `identify_and_evaluate` 把插入文本、原文和定位摘录里最长一段的词数作为 `word_limit` 写进提示；`format_identified_error` 按 `error_text:` 切分，最后一段摘录后面的 `:explanation:` 和解释一起算进它；coding agent 常常给每段摘录各配一段解释（冒烟里 CC-sonnet 的答案 8 段摘录中 7 段带着解释），于是每段都被拉长 | 上限透露了错误处的大致篇幅（一个数）；末段摘录因解释变长，相似度可能略低 | 按官方照做（候选侧提示逐字是官方函数的输出），不改；记在这里 |

判官被替换（F2）属于共同问题 C2；本项目没有重复打分（C3），单对只有 0/1，比较系统看 713 对（或所选题）的汇总命中率。

## Shared problems

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | The judges see neither the material the system was given nor the system's own code and outputs | PaperWritingBench's SxS reads two papers only (official `sxs_paper_quality.py`, `sxs_lit_review_quality.py`); PaperWrite-Bench's hallucination check compares with the original LaTeX only (pass 1 of `evaluate_per_section.py`); ResearchClawBench's judge reads the report, the checklist and images only (`evaluation/score.py`) | Method details the system made up, numbers credited to the wrong method and numbers no code computed go unnoticed, and are sometimes rewarded (P1) | New `faithfulness-judge`: every statement the document makes about its own work is checked against the materials (and an evaluator-side reference). Validation in P1, W3, R1 |
| C2 | The judge models are replaced, with sampling parameters removed | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is served by Antigravity as `gemini-4-argon-high`; the GPT judges (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5.4`) are served by codex-api as `gpt-5.6-sol`, effort medium; `temperature` and `top_p` are removed (`codex_api.toml`) | A judge's strictness and spread may differ from the official one | Every score records the served model. The substitutes have anchors: PaperWritingBench's SxS of the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (the #42 investigation); ScienceAgentBench's figure judge was run with gold, other-task gold and blank predictions on every figure task (S5); ResearchClawBench scores the same report again (R5) |
| C3 | One scoring varies | ResearchClawBench: five scorings of the same report lie between 23.7 and 29.3 (R5); PaperWrite-Bench: the same paper (run R2) scored again moved the rubric from 3.56 to 3.61, major hallucinations from 1 to 4 and claims from 241 to 227 (this Issue); PaperWritingBench: the same paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) got literature-review scores of 58 / 57 (Gemini / GPT) in #42 and 51 / 52 when scored again in this Issue; the SxS outcomes were the same both times | A difference of a few points on one item and one scoring means nothing | ResearchClawBench scores every report 2 more times and reports mean, standard deviation and range (`project_checks.repeats`); the other two need 20+ calls per scoring and are compared over many items only |
| C4 | Offline items are not fully cut off: the shield lets the Python package index through | PaperWrite-Bench's official writing agent has no network tools, the ASI-Bench leaderboard page says "no external tool access", PhysClosureBench's `network_access` is `disabled`; here the items of these three benchmarks run with the `offline` shield and additionally let through `GET`/`HEAD` on `pypi.org/simple/` and `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` (setting `shield.package_index`; every run's `setup.network` states `package_index: allowed`, #105) | The systems under test can install packages with pip and the official agents cannot; the package index holds neither the item's answer nor the paper's content, every other site (literature, papers, code hosting, search) is still 403, and the list rules (original paper, repositories) win over the exception | Recorded in every run's record and on the dashboard; the official scoring is unchanged; read an offline item's result with this network condition in mind |

## FLAWS (`flaws-judge`)

| ID | Problem | Evidence | Effect | Handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | An answer with no excerpt at all, or a Levenshtein matching that exceeds 300 s, counts as a hit in the official matching | Official `calculate_levenshtein` returns 1 for an empty prediction list, so `levenshtein_identify` returns True (the real function at pinned commit 80309b1: True for an empty list, False for one unrelated excerpt); `levenshtein_identify` uses `run_with_timeout(..., timeout=300)` and its timeout branch returns the initial True | A run that delivers an empty file or the wrong format (no `:error_text:`) would get a hit and raise the accuracy; with very long excerpts the pure-Python dynamic programme of the Levenshtein matching can exceed 300 s, which also counts as a hit | The official value is recorded as `metrics.official_hit`; `metrics.hit` and `hit_at_*` are 0 when there is no excerpt or on a timeout, and `project_checks.empty_prediction` and `project_checks.levenshtein_timeout` say so. A run without `answer.txt` has no score (`score` reports it) |
| F2 | The judge is replaced, and is no longer the model that inserted the error | Official `evaluate_llm.py` `insertion_families`: Gemini 2.5 Pro judges the 448 pairs it inserted, GPT-5 the 265 it inserted; here all 713 pairs are judged by `gpt-5.6-sol` served by codex-api (effort medium, temperature and safety_identifier dropped) | The official judge knows the style of its own errors and may be lenient; with GPT, the Gemini-inserted pairs are no longer self-judged and the strictness of both halves differs from the official one; scores are not directly comparable with the official table | Each score's `judge` records the served model and usage and `insertion` who inserted the pair; compare systems on both insertion models together, report them separately when needed; prompt and matching rule unchanged |
| F3 | The hit criterion is lenient about excerpt length, and the length limit lives in the prompt only | Levenshtein takes the best similarity of the excerpt against sentence suffixes of the inserted text and the located excerpts; the LLM judge's criterion is "one is a subset of the other". The official code checks neither that excerpts stay within `word_limit` nor their number | A long excerpt that encloses the error place may hit by the subset rule; a coding agent can do this more easily than a chat model (it can copy whole passages) | Official score recorded as is; `project_checks.answer_form` records the number of excerpts above ten and of excerpts above `word_limit`. The effect is not measured |
| F4 | The prompt carries a word limit computed from the answer key; the last excerpt carries the `:explanation:` | Official `identify_and_evaluate` writes the word count of the longest of the inserted, original and located excerpts into the prompt as `word_limit`; `format_identified_error` splits on `error_text:`, so the `:explanation:` after the last excerpt and the explanation count as part of it; a coding agent often writes an explanation after every excerpt (in the smoke run the CC-sonnet answer had 7 of 8 excerpts with one), which lengthens each of them | The limit reveals the rough size of the error place (one number); the last excerpt gets longer by the explanation and its similarity may be slightly lower | Done as the official code does (the candidate prompt is the official function's output verbatim); noted here |

The replaced judge (F2) is common problem C2; scores are not repeated (C3), a single pair is 0/1, and systems are compared on the hit rate over 713 pairs (or the chosen items).

evaluator.text:
# FLAWS manifest (Issue #158)。日期基准 2026-11-01。
id: flaws
name: FLAWS
manifest_date: 2026-11-01
status: integrated   # 接入于 #158：渲染、屏蔽、评测系统和测试已写；冒烟运行的结果在 task_interface.real_runs

source:
  paper:
    title: "FLAWS: A Benchmark for Error Identification and Localization in Scientific Papers"
    authors: ["Sarina Xi", "Vishisht Rao", "Justin Payan", "Nihar B. Shah"]
    arxiv: 2511.21843
    url: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21843
    source: 官方仓库 README 的引用块（2026-11-01）
  repo:
    url: https://github.com/xasayi/FLAWS
    pinned_commit: 80309b1948c45a43ab6b9c128247eecdf4c4db0e
    pinned_commit_date: 2025-12-14T21:35:06-05:00
    is_default_branch_head: true   # 2026-11-01 git ls-remote 的 HEAD 返回同一 SHA
    source: git ls-remote ; git log -1
  dataset:
    url: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xasayi/FLAWS
    revision: a20a57860ed4afc8a046a73abab6bd1222068762
    revision_date: 2026-05-05T00:06:02Z
    files: [ALL_OPENAI.tar.gz, ALL_GEMINI.tar.gz]
    not_used: "GEMINI_NON_ML.zip、OPENAI_NON_ML.zip：非 ML 的 CS 论文扩展（Gemini 67、GPT-5 48），不在 713 个主基准里，本项目不用（#158 建议只用 ICML 的 ML 部分）"
    source: https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/xasayi/FLAWS （2026-11-01）
  pairs: 713   # 265 个 GPT-5 插入（ALL_OPENAI）+ 448 个 Gemini 2.5 Pro 插入（ALL_GEMINI）；已核对两个 *_all.json 的条数和每对的 PDF、inserted_error、location_error 都在
  unique_papers: 472   # 241 篇论文在两个模型下各有一个错误（其中 14 对的 claim 序号相同），所以条目名里带插入模型
  venue: ICML 2025（官方数据卡和 README）
  leaderboard:
    none: 没有榜单网站；官方 README 有一张五个模型的表（published_scores）

license:
  code:
    spdx: MIT
    redistribution: allowed
    source: 仓库 LICENSE（Copyright (c) 2025 Sarina）
  data:
    spdx: CC-BY-4.0
    redistribution: "数据集卡（HF README 头部 license: cc-by-4.0）。数据里的论文是 ICML 2025 论文的改动版（LaTeX、编译的 PDF），原文的权利归各作者，数据卡没有逐篇说明；本项目不提交任何论文，只经资产使用。"
    source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/xasayi/FLAWS （2026-11-01）
  our_policy: 不提交任何数据；经 assets/flaws-hf 使用，只用于研究评测。

run:
  harness: 官方没有 agent 运行器：src/evaluate_llm.py 对每对调模型 API 一次（附 PDF），再评估
  stages:
    - stage: 1_identification
      input: "被改过的论文的压缩 PDF（altered_<claim>_small.pdf，没有就用 altered_<claim>.pdf）+ generate_error_identification_prompt(num_chunks=10, word_limit=…)"
      output: "至多 10 段 `:error_text:` 原文摘录，按严重程度排序，每段不超过 word_limit 个词，另有一段 `:explanation:`"
      note: "word_limit 是该对插入文本、原文和定位摘录里最长一段的词数（identify_and_evaluate）；提示因此带着这个数。"
      source: src/pipeline/single_process/single_error_identification.py ; src/utils/prompts.py
    - stage: 2_evaluation
      method: "命中 = 词级 Levenshtein 相似度（小写按空白切词，取摘录与插入后文本/定位摘录的最佳子句后缀）≥ 0.5，或 LLM 判官对前 10 段里任一段判 CORRECTLY IDENTIFIED（`generate_error_evaluation_prompt`、`parse_llm_as_a_judge`）；top-k 准确率 = 命中对数 / 总对数"
      judge: "插入错误的那个模型：Gemini 2.5 Pro 判 Gemini 的对，GPT-5 判 GPT-5 的对（evaluate_llm.py 的 insertion_families）"
      source: src/evaluate_llm.py ; src/utils/evaluation_helpers.py
  commands:
    install: "git clone https://github.com/xasayi/FLAWS && git checkout 80309b1948c45a43ab6b9c128247eecdf4c4db0e && conda env create -f environment.yml"
    run: "python -m src.evaluate_llm   # 改 model_family_identification / model_identification"
  official_time_limits: "没有：官方是一次 API 调用，没有 wall-clock 上限。"
  dependencies:
    packages: "评分用的三个模块（formatting、evaluation_helpers、prompts）只依赖标准库；官方环境（environment.yml）为各家模型 SDK 和 LaTeX 编译另装很多包，本项目不用。"
    source: environment.yml ; src/utils/
  gpu: 不需要。
  external_services:
    - "判官：OpenAI 兼容端点（本项目经 codex-api）；官方还要各家识别模型的 API key"

subset:
  rule: "全部 713 对（ICML 2025 的 ML 部分，GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 两种插入模型都用）；不用非 ML 的 CS 扩展。阶段三的训练题和留出题由 #157 选。"
  count_verified: 713
  formal_batch:
    rule: "没有正式批次：本 benchmark 是阶段三审稿岗位的训练环境（#141、#157），题目由 #157 选定。"
  budget:
    per_task_cap: "无：官方是一次 API 调用；本项目不设自己的上限，只受框架统一的一周上限约束。"
    judge_calls: "每对至多一次（答案里没有摘录就不调用）"
    resources: "CPU 即可；单题一份 PDF（几百 KB 到几 MB）；资产解压后约 24 GB（含压缩包）"

task_interface:
  reference: "flaws/<论文 arXiv ID 含版本>_<claim 序号>_<gpt5|gemini>，见 items"
  renderer: src/researchworld_eval/benchmarks/flaws.py
  prompt: "generate_error_identification_prompt(num_chunks=10, word_limit=…) 原文（由固定 commit 的函数生成），后接一段说明两个路径的话：PDF 在 /work/paper/paper.pdf，答案写到 /work/answer.txt（官方是聊天回复，coding agent 需要交付位置）"
  candidate: "只有被改过的论文的 PDF（只读挂载在 /work/paper/paper.pdf，官方识别用的那一份）。不给 LaTeX：官方识别器读 PDF，LaTeX 目录里有同一论文其他 claim 的改动版和（部分）原文。"
  limits: {}   # 官方一次 API 调用，没有时限；不设上限
  offline: true   # 官方识别器没有联网（提示：不要搜索网络），任务内只放行包索引
  remaining_differences: "coding agent 可以用工具读 PDF 和多次推理，官方是一次带 PDF 的 API 调用；提示末尾多了交付路径一段；判官统一为 codex-api 服务的 GPT（官方是插入错误的模型）；PDF 本身印着原论文的标题和作者（官方也是），所以标题不作屏蔽关键词，原论文由 arXiv 和 OpenReview 的地址挡住。"
  never_candidate: [inserted_error, location_error, generated_claims, identified_error, evaluation_errors, LaTeX 源码和其他 claim 的改动版, 原论文]
  deliverables: [answer.txt]
  evaluator: flaws-judge   # 官方 evaluate_error 的匹配；判官经 codex-api
  shield: src/tasks/benchmarks/flaws/shield.yaml   # 逐条的原论文（arXiv、OpenReview）、数据集页和仓库
  real_runs:
    - {run: coding-agent-flaws--2501.04179v2_10_gpt5-20261101T171819Z, date: 2026-11-01, purpose: smoke, system: "coding-agent Claude Code + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high（条件 CC-sonnet）", elapsed_s: 162, equivalent_usd: 0.372, score: "hit 0（8 段摘录，最大 Levenshtein 相似度 0.10，判官全判未命中）"}
    - {run: researchworld-flaws--2501.04179v2_10_gpt5-20261101T172241Z, date: 2026-11-01, purpose: smoke, system: "ResearchWorld HuTian 4.2.0 + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high（条件 RW-sonnet）", elapsed_s: 2081, equivalent_usd: 3.833, score: "hit 1（10 段摘录，LLM 判官命中）"}

published_scores:
  read_date: 2026-11-01

evaluator.name: README.en.md
evaluator.text:
# FLAWS

[中文](README.md) | English

The machine-readable facts are in [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml); this page says what a reader needs and points to where each fact sits in the manifest.

## What it is

FLAWS (Fault Localization Across Writing in Science) measures whether a model can find an error that was inserted into a paper and that is enough to overturn a key conclusion:
a main conclusion of an ICML 2025 paper is picked, an LLM rewrites its LaTeX to insert one error, and the paper is compiled to PDF; the tested party gets the altered paper and returns
at most 10 verbatim excerpts ranked by likelihood; a match counts as found. There are 713 paper-error pairs: 448 inserted by Gemini 2.5 Pro and 265 by GPT-5; 241 papers hold an error from each model,
472 papers in all (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.pairs`, `source.unique_papers`; the official data card).

- Paper: arXiv 2511.21843 (source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`).
- Code: `xasayi/FLAWS`, pinned commit `80309b1948c45a43ab6b9c128247eecdf4c4db0e` (MIT).
- Data: HF dataset `xasayi/FLAWS`, pinned revision `a20a57860ed4afc8a046a73abab6bd1222068762` (CC-BY-4.0); `ALL_OPENAI.tar.gz` and `ALL_GEMINI.tar.gz` are used.
  The dataset also has a non-ML CS extension (Gemini 67, GPT-5 48) that is not among the 713 main pairs and not used here (the advice of #158: ML part of ICML only).
- Data entry in this repository: asset id `flaws-hf` (the two archives and the extracted `data/`, about 24 GB, deletable and rebuildable), read through the link `assets/flaws-hf` (source: `assets/MANIFEST.yaml`).

## Licence

Code MIT, dataset CC-BY-4.0. The papers in it are altered versions of ICML 2025 papers whose rights stay with their authors; the data card does not say more per paper and this project did not check each one.
They are used for research evaluation only, never committed or redistributed (source: MANIFEST.yaml `license`).

## Items and batches

The 713 pairs are the manifest's `items`; an item name is `<arXiv id with version>_<claim index of the error>_<gpt5|gemini>`, e.g. `flaws/2506.06194v1_1_gpt5`.
The same paper holds an error from each model, so the name carries the model. `uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark flaws` lists them.

**There is no formal batch**: it is a training environment of the phase 3 review role (internal-review) (#141, #157), not an evaluation task like the E2E ones; #157 chooses the training and held-out items.
Both insertion models are included: the official table also puts the two parts together and corrects the difficulty difference by a logistic regression; the official judge is the inserting model's family and is replaced here
by a Codex GPT judge for all pairs, see F2 in [`JUDGES.en.md`](../JUDGES.en.md).

Resources: CPU only; one PDF per item (a few hundred KB to a few MB).

## How it runs and is scored

- Officially there is no agent runner: `src/evaluate_llm.py` calls a model API once per pair (compressed PDF attached, prompt `generate_error_identification_prompt`) and then evaluates (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run`).
- Hit criterion (`evaluate_error`): among the first 10 excerpts one has word-level Levenshtein similarity >= 0.5 to the inserted text or a located excerpt, or the official LLM judge says `CORRECTLY IDENTIFIED`;
  the leaderboard metric is top-k accuracy (k = 3, 10).
- The official judge is the inserting model; this project uses the GPT served by codex-api (`gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) and each score records the served model and usage. Scores are not directly comparable with the official table.

## One item: what the system gets and how it is scored (Issue #158)

Written `flaws/<item>`; any container system can run it:

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent flaws/<item> --condition CC-sonnet --purpose smoke
uv run researchworld_eval providers codex-api start
uv run researchworld_eval score flaws-judge <run-id> --credential codex=codex
```

- **Given (candidate side, rendered by `researchworld_eval.benchmarks.flaws`)**: the PDF of the altered paper, mounted read-only at `/work/paper/paper.pdf` (the one the official identifier reads: the `_small` compressed one when it exists);
  the prompt is the output of the official `generate_error_identification_prompt(num_chunks=10, word_limit=...)` verbatim, followed by one paragraph that only names the delivery path: the answer goes to `/work/answer.txt`
  (officially it is a chat reply; a coding agent needs a place to deliver). `word_limit` is computed from the answer key as the official code does (JUDGES F4).
- **Not given**: the LaTeX source (the official identifier reads the PDF; the source directory also holds the altered versions of the paper's other claims), `inserted_error`, `location_error`, `generated_claims`, other models' evaluations, the original paper.
  The framework refuses a candidate side that holds a file with an evaluation-material name. The PDF itself prints the original paper's title and authors (as officially), so the title is not a shield keyword.
- **Deliverable**: `answer.txt` in the official prompt's format: at most 10 `:error_text:` excerpts and a final `:explanation:`.
- **Time limit**: officially one API call, no limit; this benchmark sets none of its own and only the framework-wide one-week cap applies.
- **Network shield**: the official identifier is offline (the prompt says do not search the web), so it is an offline item and only the package index is allowed (common problem C4); the shield ([`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)) blocks the dataset page and the repository (the answers are public in the HF archives),
  the FLAWS paper, and each item's original paper pages on arXiv and OpenReview; the literature-search date cap is the original paper's arXiv v1 submission date.
- **Scoring**: the evaluator [`flaws-judge`](../../../evaluators/flaws_judge/README.en.md), headline `metrics.hit` (0/1), plus `hit_at_3`, `hit_at_10`, `levenshtein_hit`, `llm_hit`.

### Differences from the official protocol

- The tested party is a coding agent with tools or ResearchWorld, not one API call; it can read the PDF several times and extract text.
- The prompt ends with one more paragraph naming the delivery path; the answer is a file, not a chat reply.
- Judge: `gpt-5.6-sol` served by codex-api judges all 713 pairs; officially it is the inserting model.
- An answer with no excerpt counts as a hit in the official code; here it does not (JUDGES F1).

## Published reference scores

Read 2026-11-01 from the table in the official repository README (top-k accuracy over 713 pairs; the judge is the inserting model):

| model | β | k = 3 | k = 10 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GPT 5 | 2.10 | 19.2% | 39.1% |
| Deepseek Reasoner v3.1 | 1.90 | 16.3% | 35.2% |
| Grok 4 | 1.68 | 16.3% | 23.4% |
| Claude Sonnet 4.5 | 1.47 | 12.6% | 21.5% |
| Gemini 2.5 Pro | 1.41 | 15.7% | 19.8% |

(Source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`. The judges differ, so only hit rates over the same set of items are comparable.)

## Smoke (Issue #158)

The same item `flaws/2501.04179v2_10_gpt5` (15 pages, inserted by GPT-5, `--purpose smoke`), once per system, judge `gpt-5.6-sol` (codex-api, `--credential codex=codex`):

| system | run | wall clock | cost (price-list equivalent, nothing charged on a subscription) | hit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CC-sonnet (coding-agent, Claude Code + `claude-sonnet-5-5`, high) | `coding-agent-flaws--2501.04179v2_10_gpt5-20261101T171819Z` | 162 s | $0.372 | 0 (8 excerpts, best similarity 0.10, the judge said INCORRECT for all) |
| RW-sonnet (ResearchWorld, HuTian 4.2.0, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, high) | `researchworld-flaws--2501.04179v2_10_gpt5-20261101T172241Z` | 2081 s | $3.833 | 1 (10 excerpts, the LLM judge hit, best Levenshtein similarity 0.17) |

This only shows that the integration runs through (render, shield self-test, delivery, scoring) and compares nothing: one item, one run each, and a hit is 0/1.

evaluator.name: README.md
evaluator.text:
# FLAWS

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

机器可读的事实在 [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml)；本文只说明读者需要知道的内容，并指出每条事实在 manifest 里的位置。

## 是什么

FLAWS（Fault Localization Across Writing in Science）衡量模型能不能在一篇论文里找到被人为插入的、足以推翻关键结论的错误：
从 ICML 2025 的论文里取一个主要结论，由 LLM 改写 LaTeX 插入一处错误，编译成 PDF；被测者拿到改过的论文，交出至多 10 段按可能性排序的原文摘录，
命中则算找到。共 713 个“论文—错误”对：448 个由 Gemini 2.5 Pro 插入，265 个由 GPT-5 插入；同一篇论文在两个模型下各有一个错误的有 241 篇，共 472 篇论文
（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.pairs`、`source.unique_papers`；官方数据卡）。

- 论文：arXiv 2511.21843（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.paper`）。
- 代码：`xasayi/FLAWS`，固定 commit `80309b1948c45a43ab6b9c128247eecdf4c4db0e`（MIT）。
- 数据：HF 数据集 `xasayi/FLAWS`，固定 revision `a20a57860ed4afc8a046a73abab6bd1222068762`（CC-BY-4.0）；用 `ALL_OPENAI.tar.gz` 和 `ALL_GEMINI.tar.gz`。
  数据集另有非 ML 的 CS 扩展（Gemini 67、GPT-5 48），不在 713 个主基准里，本项目不用（#158 的建议：只用 ICML 的 ML 部分）。
- 本仓库的数据入口：资产 id `flaws-hf`（两个压缩包和解压后的 `data/`，约 24 GB，可删除后重建），经 `assets/flaws-hf` 链接读取（来源：`assets/MANIFEST.yaml`）。

## 许可

官方代码 MIT，数据集 CC-BY-4.0。数据里的论文是 ICML 2025 论文的改动版，原文权利归各作者；数据卡没有逐篇说明，本项目没有逐篇核对，只把它们用于研究评测，不提交、不再分发
（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `license`）。

## 题目和批次

713 对的名单是 manifest 的 `items`，条目名是 `<arXiv 号含版本>_<错误所在的 claim 序号>_<gpt5|gemini>`，例如 `flaws/2506.06194v1_1_gpt5`。
同一篇论文在两个模型下各有一个错误，所以名里带模型。`uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark flaws` 列出它们。

**没有正式批次**：它是阶段三审稿岗位（internal-review）的训练环境（#141、#157），不是 E2E 那样的评测题；训练题和留出题由 #157 选定。
两种插入模型都纳入：官方榜单里也是把两部分放在一起，用逻辑回归校正难度差异；官方判官与插入模型同一家，这里统一换成 Codex 的 GPT 判官，影响见 [`JUDGES.md`](../JUDGES.md) 的 F2。

资源：只要 CPU；一题一份 PDF（几百 KB 到几 MB）。

## 怎么运行和评分

- 官方没有 agent 运行器：`src/evaluate_llm.py` 对每对调一次模型 API（附压缩 PDF，提示 `generate_error_identification_prompt`），再评估（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run`）。
- 命中判据（`evaluate_error`）：前 10 段摘录里，有一段与插入后的文本或定位摘录的词级 Levenshtein 相似度 ≥ 0.5，或官方 LLM 判官判为 `CORRECTLY IDENTIFIED`；
  榜单指标是 top-k 准确率（k = 3、10）。
- 官方判官是插入错误的那个模型；本项目由 codex-api 服务的 GPT 担任（`gpt-5.6-sol`，medium），每条分数记实际服务的模型和用量。分数不与官方榜单直接可比。

## 一道题：交给系统什么、怎么评分（Issue #158）

写作 `flaws/<条目>`，任何容器类被测系统都可以运行：

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent flaws/<条目> --condition CC-sonnet --purpose smoke
uv run researchworld_eval providers codex-api start
uv run researchworld_eval score flaws-judge <run-id> --credential codex=codex
```

- **给系统的（候选侧，`researchworld_eval.benchmarks.flaws` 渲染）**：被改过的论文的 PDF，只读挂载在 `/work/paper/paper.pdf`（官方识别用的那一份：有 `_small` 压缩版用压缩版）；
  提示是官方 `generate_error_identification_prompt(num_chunks=10, word_limit=…)` 的输出原文，后接一段只说交付路径的话：答案写到 `/work/answer.txt`
  （官方是聊天回复，coding agent 需要交付位置）。`word_limit` 照官方由答案算出（JUDGES.md F4）。
- **不给的**：LaTeX 源码（官方识别器读 PDF；源码目录里还有同一论文其他 claim 的改动版）、`inserted_error`、`location_error`、`generated_claims`、其他模型的评估结果、原论文。
  框架拒绝含评测材料名字的候选侧。PDF 自带原论文的标题和作者（官方也是），所以标题不作屏蔽关键词。
- **交付物**：`answer.txt`，格式同官方提示：至多 10 段 `:error_text:` 摘录，最后一段 `:explanation:`。
- **时间上限**：官方是一次 API 调用，没有时限；这个 benchmark 不设自己的上限，只受框架统一的一周上限约束。
- **联网屏蔽**：官方识别器不联网（提示要求不搜索网络），所以是离线题，只放行包索引（共同问题 C4）；屏蔽表（[`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)）挡数据集页和仓库（答案在 HF 压缩包里公开）、
  FLAWS 论文，以及每个条目的原论文在 arXiv 和 OpenReview 的页面；文献检索的日期上限是原论文 arXiv v1 的提交日。
- **评分**：评测系统 [`flaws-judge`](../../../evaluators/flaws_judge/README.md)，主分数 `metrics.hit`（0/1），另记 `hit_at_3`、`hit_at_10`、`levenshtein_hit`、`llm_hit`。

### 与官方协议的差异

- 被测者是带工具的 coding agent 或 ResearchWorld，不是一次 API 调用；它可以多次读 PDF、抽取文字。
- 提示末尾多一段交付路径；答案是文件，不是聊天回复。
- 判官：codex-api 服务的 `gpt-5.6-sol` 判全部 713 对，官方是插入错误的模型。
- 答案里没有摘录时官方会算命中，这里不算（JUDGES.md F1）。

## 公开对照分数

读取日 2026-11-01，来自官方仓库 README 的表（top-k 准确率，713 对；判官是插入错误的模型）：

| 模型 | β | k = 3 | k = 10 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GPT 5 | 2.10 | 19.2% | 39.1% |
| Deepseek Reasoner v3.1 | 1.90 | 16.3% | 35.2% |
| Grok 4 | 1.68 | 16.3% | 23.4% |
| Claude Sonnet 4.5 | 1.47 | 12.6% | 21.5% |
| Gemini 2.5 Pro | 1.41 | 15.7% | 19.8% |

（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`。判官不同，只有同一批题上的命中率才有可比性。）

## 冒烟（Issue #158）

同一道题 `flaws/2501.04179v2_10_gpt5`（15 页，GPT-5 插入，`--purpose smoke`），两个系统各一次，判官 `gpt-5.6-sol`（codex-api，`--credential codex=codex`）：

system.name: researchworld
system.description: HuTian ResearchWorld 4.8.2, this project's own install (images :rwe-v4.8.2)

agent.name: Claude Code
agent.how: one agent per role through acpx's ACP adapter in the role's sandbox container

network.search: the shared search tool (MCP server rwe-search in every sandbox) through the same shield
network.web_access: every request of every role through the run's shield proxy, HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy with the shield's CA: the same URL, keyword, id and date rules as the other systems, the shield logs each URL; no direct way out, server-side search and remote tools off (Issue #73)

tools.permissions: acpx --approve-all --non-interactive-permissions fail: every tool call the agent asks for is approved; the role's sandbox container is the boundary

preinstalled.zh: HuTian 的 system image researchworld:rwe-v4.8.2 和 worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.8.2（acpx 与各 agent 的 ACP 适配、researchworld 包的 Python、Node.js）
preinstalled.en: HuTian's system image researchworld:rwe-v4.8.2 and worker image researchworld-worker:rwe-v4.8.2 (acpx and each agent's ACP adapter, Python with the researchworld packages, Node.js)

reasons.resources.cpus: world.json sets no resources: each role's sandbox gets HuTian's defaults
reasons.limits.time_limit_hours: the world configuration sets no budget.total_seconds: `run --hours` or the run's settings file sets it

meaning.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型；provider —，推理强度 high。
meaning.en: ResearchWorld: all 9 roles for E2E tasks; benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model in every role; provider —, reasoning effort high.

conditions.name: RW-sol
conditions.description: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型（Codex）
conditions.description_en: ResearchWorld: all 9 roles for E2E tasks; benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model (Codex) in every role
conditions.notes: 维护者 2026-10-29 加（#87）：所有岗位用 HuTian 现有的 Codex worker，gpt-6.1-sol、effort high，和 CX-sol 同模型同档 effort，成对比较“RW 用 Codex 能不能超过单个 Codex agent”。Codex 岗位直接用项目自己的 Codex 登录 `codex-2-rw`（HuTian 的 HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE，不经 codex-api：HuTian 的强制代理只放行官方端点；`codex-2-rw` 是 `codex-2` 同一个账号的第二次独立登录，有自己的 refresh token，维护者 2026-11-02 定，#185），GPT 判官用 `codex`，所以和判官不共用登录和额度；和经 codex-api 用 `codex-2` 的 CX-sol、AS-sol、ARC-sol、EVO-sol 可以同时运行，只共用账号的用量额度（preflight 在同一批次里两者并存时打印 note）；RW-sol 和 RW-mixed 的 Codex 岗位读的是同一个登录文件，由 HuTian 自己的锁串行刷新。RW-astra 和混合版暂不加。
conditions.notes_en: Added by the maintainer on 2026-10-29 (#87): every role uses HuTian's existing Codex worker, gpt-6.1-sol at effort high, the same model and effort as CX-sol for a paired comparison of whether RW with Codex can beat a single Codex agent. The Codex roles use the project's own Codex login `codex-2-rw` directly (HuTian's HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE, not through codex-api: HuTian's mandatory proxy admits only the official endpoints; `codex-2-rw` is a second, independent sign-in of the `codex-2` account with its own refresh token, maintainer, 2026-11-02, #185), and the GPT judges use `codex`, so they share neither the login nor the quota with the judges; RW-sol can run at the same time as CX-sol, AS-sol, ARC-sol and EVO-sol, which use `codex-2` through codex-api, and they only share the account's usage allowance (preflight prints a note when a batch holds both); RW-sol and the Codex roles of RW-mixed read the same login file, and HuTian's own lock serialises their refreshes. RW-astra and a mixed variant are not added for now.

preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator has its run's private docker socket; the privileged daemon is root-equivalent.

Upstream's prompts, phases and algorithm are unchanged.

conditions.notes: 维护者 2026-11-02 定（#193）：模型调用经本机 sub2api 服务（Anthropic 兼容，背后是 Claude 订阅），不再用已无余额的 ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY。条件里 provider 仍是 anthropic（ARC 的 llm.provider=anthropic）；路线由凭据变量名 SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC 决定，运行记录的 credentials 写这个名字。请求的格式、提示和算法不变；容器里 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 只是占位符，联网屏蔽代理持有 key 和服务地址。
conditions.notes_en: Maintainer, 2026-11-02 (#193): model calls go through the local sub2api service (Anthropic-compatible, on a Claude subscription) instead of ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY, whose balance is gone. The condition's provider stays anthropic (ARC's llm.provider=anthropic); the route follows the credential variable SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC, which the run record's credentials name. Request format, prompts and algorithm are unchanged; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the container is a placeholder, the shield proxy holds the key and the service's address.

agent.name: none
agent.how: no coding agent: a 23-stage prompt-chain pipeline over the Anthropic Messages API

network.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).

tools.permissions: no tool calls (requests carry model, messages, max_tokens); generated experiments run in experiment containers ARC starts (E2E tasks, docker mode) or as plain subprocesses in the container (benchmark items)

preinstalled.zh: python:3.11 bookworm；上游代码按 PYTHONPATH 使用；pdflatex + bibtex；CPU 版 PyTorch 和 numpy、scipy、scikit-learn、pandas、matplotlib 等（constraints.txt 固定）；实验镜像另有 ARC 提示所列的 torchvision、transformers、datasets、h5py 等（experiment-constraints.txt 固定）
preinstalled.en: python:3.11 bookworm; upstream code via PYTHONPATH; pdflatex + bibtex; CPU PyTorch with numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, pandas, matplotlib and more (pinned by constraints.txt); the experiment image adds the torchvision, transformers, datasets, h5py and others the ARC prompt lists (experiment-constraints.txt)

notes.model: claude-sonnet-5-5 through the Anthropic Messages API (llm.provider=anthropic), no fallback models, reviewer model = same model. Requests carry model, messages and max_tokens only (no tools); thinking: {'type': 'between_tools'} is sent, which turns thinking off; ARC's per-stage temperature is not sent because the model rejects it, so the API default applies.
notes.agent: ARC is not a tool-using coding agent: its 23-stage pipeline, its own code agent and its reviewers are prompt chains over plain chat completions. conditions.agent=claude means only that the provider is Anthropic; Claude Code is not involved. E2E tasks run ARC's own docker mode (experiment.mode=docker, docker.network_policy=setup_only, #220): every generated experiment runs in a fresh container of the experiment image (the same CPU Python stack as ARC's image, started by ARC through the host docker socket, on the run's shield network, with the condition's cpus and memory). ARC's entrypoint there installs requirements.txt, runs the generated setup.py (network through the shield: the task's data is downloaded here, into /workspace/data), cuts the network (iptables) and only then runs main.py. A benchmark item keeps experiment.mode=sandbox (a plain subprocess in ARC's container, no network from the experiment's point of view: ARC's code-generation prompt for that mode forbids external data).
notes.experiment: E2E tasks run ARC's own docker mode (experiment.mode=docker, docker.network_policy=setup_only, #220): every generated experiment runs in a fresh container of the experiment image (the same CPU Python stack as ARC's image, started by ARC through the host docker socket, on the run's shield network, with the condition's cpus and memory). ARC's entrypoint there installs requirements.txt, runs the generated setup.py (network through the shield: the task's data is downloaded here, into /workspace/data), cuts the network (iptables) and only then runs main.py. A benchmark item keeps experiment.mode=sandbox (a plain subprocess in ARC's container, no network from the experiment's point of view: ARC's code-generation prompt for that mode forbids external data).
notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; usage-log.patch sends output_config.effort='high' with every request. Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 think by default and ARC's per-stage max_tokens (4096, 8192, 16384) is shared with the thinking tokens: at high effort a stage can end with thinking only and no text (#106). Thinking is turned off where the model allows it (systems.autoresearchclaw.thinking).
notes.venue: Not chosen by the system: export.target_conference=iclr_2026 comes from [systems.autoresearchclaw].
notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. A logging-only patch (usage-log.patch) appends each Messages API `usage` block to anthropic-usage.jsonl; cost is not computed. The same patch carries the RWE_OMIT_TEMPERATURE, RWE_EFFORT and RWE_THINKING switches.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s (in docker mode ARC passes it as the timeout of the whole container: pip install, setup.py and main.py), refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md with whitespace collapsed, in its faithful English version (candidate/TASK.en.md) when the task has one (#196: the keywords ARC's literature screen filters by are taken from the ASCII words of the topic, and a Chinese topic leaves only the file names it mentions); the run's result says which text it was (notes.topic_source). Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.
notes.search: Web search, crawling, GitHub, HF Hub, Gemini and OpenCode are off. Literature search in stage 4 uses ['openalex', 'semantic_scholar'] through ARC's own clients behind the shield proxy; stages 8, 17, 22 and 23 (novelty, citation verification) always also query arXiv, CrossRef and DataCite; the shield date-bounds those API calls like the others (a late DOI answers 403).

conditions.name: ARC-sol
conditions.notes: 维护者 2026-11-02 加（#185）：阶段一的 GPT-6.1 Sol 列。ARC 用自带的 OpenAI 兼容客户端（llm.provider=openai-compatible、wire_api=responses）经 codex-api 用 `codex-2`；ARC 没有 effort 设置，openai-route.patch 在每个请求里带 reasoning.effort（和 Anthropic 路线的 output_config.effort 补丁同理，只读观测之外唯一的改动）。ARC 各阶段的 max_tokens 在这条路线上不会被思考吃满（#106 的问题）：ARC 发的 max_output_tokens 和 temperature 都被 codex-api 在请求到 Codex 之前去掉，所以 #106 的问题在这条路线上不存在。 effort 为 medium，与其他条件的 high 不同（维护者 2026-11-04 定，#227）：经 ChatGPT 订阅（Codex 登录）线路，OpenAI 后端约在 900 s 时复位单个请求的流（codex-api 回 500，#223），ARC 第 10 阶段用一个请求生成全部实验代码，high 下常超过 15 分钟，被切后 ARC 重试同一请求又撞同一上限；降低 effort 是设定实验条件的请求参数（先例：ARC-opus，#106），不改 ARC 的提示、阶段和算法。
conditions.notes_en: Added by the maintainer on 2026-11-02 (#185): the GPT-6.1 Sol column of phase 1. ARC uses its own OpenAI-compatible client (llm.provider=openai-compatible, wire_api=responses) through codex-api on `codex-2`; ARC has no effort setting, so openai-route.patch puts reasoning.effort on every request (as the output_config.effort patch does for the Anthropic route; apart from read-only logging the only change). ARC's per-stage max_tokens cannot be eaten by thinking on this route (the problem of #106): the max_output_tokens and temperature ARC sends are removed by codex-api before the request reaches Codex, so the problem of #106 does not exist on this route. Effort is medium, unlike the high of the other conditions (maintainer, 2026-11-04, #227): on the ChatGPT-subscription (Codex login) route OpenAI's backend resets a single request's stream at about 900 s (codex-api answers 500, #223); ARC stage 10 generates all the experiment code in one request, which at high often runs past 15 minutes, and after the cut ARC retries the same request into the same limit. Lowering the effort is a request parameter that sets the experiment condition (precedent: ARC-opus, #106); ARC's prompts, stages and algorithm are untouched.

notes.model: gpt-6.1-sol through the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login on codex-api  (account ), ARC's OpenAI-compatible client with llm.provider=openai-compatible and wire_api=responses, no fallback models, reviewer model = same model. ARC sends model, input, max_output_tokens and (it sends it for every model that is not o3/o4) temperature; codex-api removes max_output_tokens and temperature before the request reaches Codex, so neither takes effect.
notes.agent: ARC is not a tool-using coding agent: its 23-stage pipeline, its own code agent and its reviewers are prompt chains over plain model calls. conditions.agent=codex means only that the provider is the project's Codex login through codex-api; the Codex CLI is not involved. E2E tasks run ARC's own docker mode (experiment.mode=docker, docker.network_policy=setup_only, #220): every generated experiment runs in a fresh container of the experiment image (the same CPU Python stack as ARC's image, started by ARC through the host docker socket, on the run's shield network, with the condition's cpus and memory). ARC's entrypoint there installs requirements.txt, runs the generated setup.py (network through the shield: the task's data is downloaded here, into /workspace/data), cuts the network (iptables) and only then runs main.py. A benchmark item keeps experiment.mode=sandbox (a plain subprocess in ARC's container, no network from the experiment's point of view: ARC's code-generation prompt for that mode forbids external data).
notes.experiment: E2E tasks run ARC's own docker mode (experiment.mode=docker, docker.network_policy=setup_only, #220): every generated experiment runs in a fresh container of the experiment image (the same CPU Python stack as ARC's image, started by ARC through the host docker socket, on the run's shield network, with the condition's cpus and memory). ARC's entrypoint there installs requirements.txt, runs the generated setup.py (network through the shield: the task's data is downloaded here, into /workspace/data), cuts the network (iptables) and only then runs main.py. A benchmark item keeps experiment.mode=sandbox (a plain subprocess in ARC's container, no network from the experiment's point of view: ARC's code-generation prompt for that mode forbids external data).
notes.effort: ARC has no effort setting; openai-route.patch sends reasoning.effort='medium' with every request (RWE_EFFORT). The per-stage max_tokens (4096, 8192, 16384) that the thinking of a Claude model eats up (#106) is not sent on this route (codex-api removes max_output_tokens), so thinking cannot starve a stage's text.
notes.venue: Not chosen by the system: export.target_conference=iclr_2026 comes from [systems.autoresearchclaw].
notes.tokens: ARC records no usage. openai-route.patch appends each response's `usage` block and the request seconds to anthropic-usage.jsonl (the same log as the Messages API route); cost is not computed, there is no per-token charge on a ChatGPT plan.
notes.time: No global wall-clock or budget cap in ARC; only the runner's limit applies. Per experiment run 3600 s (in docker mode ARC passes it as the timeout of the whole container: pip install, setup.py and main.py), refinement iterations 10, repair cycles 3.
notes.input: Chinese pack text goes verbatim (candidate files concatenated, with <!-- file --> markers) into prompts.extra_prompts of 18 stages. ARC takes one topic string and checks generated code against it, so research.topic is the candidate TASK.md with whitespace collapsed, in its faithful English version (candidate/TASK.en.md) when the task has one (#196: the keywords ARC's literature screen filters by are taken from the ASCII words of the topic, and a Chinese topic leaves only the file names it mentions); the run's result says which text it was (notes.topic_source). Literature queries come from the stage-3 model plan; ARC's ASCII keyword splitter and its whitespace-based query expansion yield a few useless queries from the Chinese text. Starter papers are guidance text only: ARC cannot ingest seed papers.

The only host address the shield lets through is codex-api's model routes.

conditions.name: EVO-sonnet
conditions.notes: 维护者 2026-11-02 定（#193）：模型调用经本机 sub2api 服务（Anthropic 兼容，背后是 Claude 订阅），不再用已无余额的 ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY_2。条件里 provider 仍是 anthropic（EvoScientist 原生的 Anthropic provider，只多一个 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL）；路线由凭据变量名 SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC 决定。提示和算法不变；容器里 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 只是占位符，联网屏蔽代理持有 key 和服务地址。
conditions.notes_en: Maintainer, 2026-11-02 (#193): model calls go through the local sub2api service (Anthropic-compatible, on a Claude subscription) instead of ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY_2, whose balance is gone. The condition's provider stays anthropic (EvoScientist's native Anthropic provider with one extra ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL); the route follows the credential variable SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC. Prompts and algorithm are unchanged; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the container is a placeholder, the shield proxy holds the key and the service's address.

agent.name: none
agent.how: no external coding agent: EvoScientist's in-process sub-agents (LangChain deepagents)

tools.permissions: think_tool, deepagents built-ins, EvoSkills skills and an execute shell; skill_manager not registered; no search tool

preinstalled.zh: 上游锁定依赖（uv sync --frozen）加兼容补丁 compat.patch；TeX Live（含 fonts-extra、latexmk）；给 agent 用的研究 Python 环境 /opt/research
preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 1800 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.

meaning.en: EvoScientist; provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.
